subject: financial_literacy
concept: Tracking progress toward a savings goal over time
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student adds play money to a savings tracker each time they 'earn' some, over several rounds
exercise.pictorial: Student reads a savings tracker to determine how much more is needed to reach a goal
exercise.abstract: Student calculates how much more needs to be saved to reach a stated goal

misconception_flags: miscalculates the remaining amount needed by adding instead of subtracting, or vice versa

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
